name: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the students belonging to socially and educationally backward class and Open Category (Economically weaker section) students
description: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the students belonging to Socially and Educationally backward class and Open Category (Economically Weaker Section) students and admitted to the seats under PPP scheme in Government ITIs and Private ITIs through Centralized Admission Process. They will avail Fee Reimbursement benefit only if they met the Scheme Criteria.
department: Skill Development, Employement And Entrepreneurship Department
implementingAuthority: Skill Development, Employement And Entrepreneurship Department

criteria.label: 1. Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Industrial Training Institute or Private Industrial Training Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.

evidence.quote: 1. Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Industrial Training Institute or Private Industrial Training Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.
3.Student should belong to OPEN Category and Economical Weaker Section (EWS).

criteria.label: 4.Overall Family Income will be considered (Father + Mother Income)

evidence.quote: 4.Overall Family Income will be considered (Father + Mother Income)

criteria.label: 6.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

evidence.quote: 6.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

criteria.label: 7.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.

evidence.quote: 7.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.

criteria.label: 9.Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses.

evidence.quote: 9.Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses.

criteria.label: 12.Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If any medical emergency then after recommendation by institute Regional Joint Director should certify or recommend.

evidence.quote: 12.Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If any medical emergency then after recommendation by institute Regional Joint Director should certify or recommend.

criteria.label: 13.Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for scholarship.

evidence.quote: 13.Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for scholarship.

benefits.text:
( As Per GR Dated 29.05.2019)
1. Family income above 2,50,000 to Less than or up to 8,00,000 Lakh then 80 % of (Private Institute Course Fee - Government Institute Course fee).
2. Family income Less than or equal to 2,50,000 then 100 % of (Private Institute Course Fee - Government Institute Course fee).

applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
